data.title: 椎叶紬 · 橱窗前的发箍
data.description: 服装店外，紬把红色发箍举到眼前，比了比橱窗里的颜色。她已经在这里站了一会儿，仍没决定要不要买。
data.action: holding a hairband beside the shop window
data.promptProse: Outside a fashionable boutique on a sunlit shopping promenade, Tsumugi holds a polished red polka-dot hairband up beside her reflection in the clean shop window glass. Mannequins in stylish autumn ensembles, potted topiaries, and walking shoppers create a vibrant town backdrop as she checks how the accessory complements her short hair.
